blockedPlaceholders.reason: BM-096 render-fidelity now passes, but 15 remaining fields still have BAD_LABEL plus GENERIC_FIELD_CANONICALIZATION. Their raw patterns are generic document.fieldN placeholders with weak same-BM semantic evidence. Auto-remapping these as a batch would risk label-only or path-domain mistakes.

Render gate pass proves no unresolved DOCX placeholders or undefined/null literals, but BM-096 still has unresolved semantic/path-domain metadata issues. DONE requires no unresolved legal/human blocker.
